name: AppLayout
summary: A working app: a collapsible sidebar of places, a header, and the view, which scrolls on its own; optionally a details column beside it. For tools people work in all day: a tracker, an admin, a dashboard, a mail client. Not for a conversation (ChatLayout), an editor with a canvas (EditorLayout) or a website (SiteLayout).
a11y: The sidebar is a labelled `aside` the header's toggle controls (`aria-expanded`); the view is the `main` region, named by `label`; the details column is a labelled `aside` after it in the source. The view's scroller is focusable, so the keyboard can scroll it. In a narrow window the floating sidebar closes with Escape and returns focus to the toggle. With `startMode`, a floating sidebar also closes on a press outside it and its toggle; the pin (with `onStartModeChange`) is a toggle button named "Pin" and the sidebar's label, pressed (`aria-pressed`) while docked. `width="edge"` keeps the view the `main` region, named by `label`, without the layout's scroller.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: The sidebar: the product's places (Navigation), a switcher, the account.

props.name: sidebarOpen
props.description: Whether the sidebar shows. In a narrow window it floats over the content while open.

props.name: onSidebarToggle
props.description: The sidebar toggle in the header was pressed.

props.name: header
props.description: The header after the toggle: where you are (Breadcrumbs) or the view's controls.

props.name: headerEnd
props.description: The header's end: search, the main action, the account.

props.name: head
props.description: The view's head: its title (and a line under it). It leads everything in the view, one unit at the page level above the view's content.

props.name: children
props.description: The view: it scrolls on its own, with the page margin around it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the view's region: the view's title.

props.name: aside
props.description: A details column beside the view (an item's fields); under it in a narrow window.

props.name: width
props.description: `full` lets the view take the whole width (a board that scrolls sideways); `column` holds it to a readable width; `edge` gives the view the whole main area under the header, with no page margin and no scroller of its own (an EditorLayout with `height="fill"`, which scrolls its own panels). `head` and `aside` don't apply with `edge`.

props.name: startMode
props.description: How the sidebar sits beside the view. Left out: docked, floating over the view below 48 rem of the layout's own width. `docked`: always beside the view. `floating`: always over the view, under the header, closing on a press outside it and its toggle (and on Escape). `auto`: docked from `floatBelow` of the layout's own width, floating under it.

props.name: floatBelow
props.description: With `startMode="auto"`: the layout width below which the sidebar floats, a CSS length in px, rem or em (default "48rem").

props.name: onStartModeChange
props.description: Adds a pin at the top of the sidebar while it can dock (not while `auto` floats it): pressed while docked; pressing it asks for the other mode. The parent owns the mode: set `startMode` here.

props.name: height
props.description: `fill` takes the height its parent gives it; `screen` the whole window (an app on its own); `lg` holds a set height (a demonstration).

props.name: headerSpan
props.description: `main` (default): the header tops the main area and the sidebar runs the full height beside it. `across`: the header spans the whole layout and the sidebar sits under it, docked or floating (an app whose bar holds its name).

props.name: labels
props.description: The sidebar controls' names, in the product's words. `open` and `close` name the header's toggle (default "Open sidebar", "Close sidebar"; give both the same words to keep one name, its state carried by `aria-expanded`). `pin` names the pin (default "Pin" and the sidebar's label), announced as pressed while docked; with `unpin` the pin's name changes instead ("Pin navigation", "Unpin navigation") and it isn't a toggle button.

props.name: size
props.description: `m` (default) a 56 px header and a 16 rem sidebar; `s` a dense app frame (LR41, LR42), a desktop editor's 40 px bar, a 13 rem sidebar and the view's title a section's step over its content. Pair it with Navigation `size="s"`.

settings.description: A rule under the header (default 0px, none). Set var(--border-hairline) for an app whose bar is ruled off from the sidebar and the view.
